caption:
👥 Africa's most populated countries — 1800 → 2025.

The whole continent held about 100 million people in 1800. Nigeria alone has 238 million today. Deaths fell fast in the 20th century, births are falling much more slowly — that gap is the curve you're watching. Ethiopia passes Egypt in 2009, Tanzania passes South Africa in 2020.

📊 Data: World Bank (1960–2025) and Gapminder (before 1960), CC BY 4.0. Before 1950 the figures are sparse reconstructions, mostly interpolated between census estimates.
